commands.author: qingminglong

target.title: fix(message): preserve stringified channelData payloads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where message actions that pass channel-specific `channelData` as a JSON string could lose that payload or fail to treat it as send content when the visible text is blank or removed.

## Why This Change Was Made

The message tool, outbound runner, and embedded subscribe rich-content tracker now parse `channelData` with the same structured JSON boundary used for sibling message payload fields. Opaque `channelData` remains fail-closed when it contains protected internal runtime context, while ordinary visible text keeps the safe text that remains after protected context is stripped. The runner now counts valid object-shaped `channelData` as real send content without adding config, schema, provider, or compatibility behavior.

Duplicate search found no open or closed overlapping PRs or open issues for `channelData JSON message action`, `stringified channelData`, `message-tool channelData idempotency`, or `parseJsonMessageParam channelData`; open self PRs had no same-root outbound/message parameter normalization overlap.

## User Impact

Channel-native cards, buttons, and other provider payload metadata can be preserved when passed as JSON strings, including internal source replies that intentionally carry channel-specific structured data without visible text. Protected runtime context remains filtered before opaque payloads can be sent, and normal visible text around a stripped protected block is still delivered.

## Evidence

### Real internal-source proof (exact head `a2d99271305f1911fe98c8822af24e2605b1efb0`)

Command:

```powershell
@' <script omitted: calls createMessageTool({ currentChannelProvider: "webchat", sourceReplyDeliveryMode: "message_tool_only" }).execute(...) without injecting runMessageAction and without dryRun> '@ | node --import tsx --input-type=module -
```

Observed redacted terminal output:

```json
{
  "head": "a2d99271305f1911fe98c8822af24e2605b1efb0",
  "invoked": "createMessageTool.execute",
  "injectedRunMessageAction": false,
  "dryRun": false,
  "safe": {
    "status": "ok",
    "deliveryStatus": "sent",
    "sourceReplyDeliveryMode": "message_tool_only",
    "sourceReplySink": "internal-ui",
    "channel": "webchat",
    "target": "current-run",
    "deliveredChannelData": {
      "webchat": {
        "cardId": "proof-card-only"
      }
    },
    "visibleText": "",
    "toolContentText": "Sent visible reply to the current source conversation via internal-ui."
  },
  "protectedContextRejected": {
    "status": true,
    "reason": "internal_runtime_context_echo",
    "leakedMarker": false,
    "dispatchedToInternalUi": false
  },
  "mixedVisibleText": {
    "deliveryStatus": "sent",
    "sourceReplySink": "internal-ui",
    "deliveredText": "Please summarize:",
    "leakedMarker": false
  }
}
```

Claim proved: stringified `channelData` is parsed before message-tool dispatch and outbound runner validation, channelData-only sends remain dispatchable after visible text is stripped, embedded rich-content detection still recognizes channelData-only payloads, protected internal runtime context inside opaque `channelData` keys or values suppresses the opaque payload before internal-ui dispatch, and ordinary visible text around a stripped protected block is preserved.

Focused regression proof:

```powershell
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tools/message-tool.test.ts -t "keeps safe stringified channelData|drops stringified channelData|suppresses sends when visible text and stringified channelData|keeps ordinary visible text|suppresses pure internal-runtime-context"
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/outbound/message-action-runner.send-validation.test.ts -t "channelData"
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.test.ts -t "rich-content"
```

Observed result: message-tool regression proof passed with 14 tests and 286 skipped; outbound send-validation passed with 1 test and 30 skipped; embedded rich-content detection passed with 2 tests and 256 skipped.

Targeted format passed:

```powershell
node_modules\.bin\oxfmt.CMD --check --threads=1 src\agents\tools\message-tool.ts src\agents\tools\message-tool-content.ts src\agents\tools\message-tool.test.ts src\infra\outbound\message-action-runner.ts src\agents\embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.ts src\infra\outbound\message-action-structured-content.ts
```

Diff hygiene passed:

```powershell
git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD
```
